sql: SELECT 'g1.prc' f, COUNT(*) tot, COUNT(prc) nn FROM items_g1 UNION ALL SELECT 'g2.prc', COUNT(*), COUNT(prc) FROM items_g2 UNION ALL SELECT 'g2.prc_usd', COUNT(*), COUNT(prc_usd) FROM items_g2 UNION ALL SELECT 'g3.prc', COUNT(*), COUNT(prc) FROM items_g3
SELECT 'g1' g, MIN(prc) mn, MAX(prc) mx, AVG(prc) av FROM items_g1 UNION ALL SELECT 'g2', MIN(prc), MAX(prc), AVG(prc) FROM items_g2 UNION ALL SELECT 'g3', MIN(prc), MAX(prc), AVG(prc) FROM items_g3
SELECT prc, prc_usd, COUNT(*) n FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY prc, prc_usd ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT MIN(prc_usd) mn, MAX(prc_usd) mx, AVG(prc_usd) av, COUNT(*) n FROM items_g2 WHERE prc_usd IS NOT NULL
SELECT 'attrs_g1' t, attr_key, COUNT(*) n FROM attrs_g1 GROUP BY attr_key ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT 'attrs_g3' t, attr_key, COUNT(*) n FROM attrs_g3 GROUP BY attr_key ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT 'g1' g, cat_lvl, cat_nm, COUNT(*) n FROM taxn_g1 GROUP BY cat_lvl, cat_nm ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT 'g2' g, cat_lvl, cat_nm, COUNT(*) n FROM taxn_g2 GROUP BY cat_lvl, cat_nm ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ref_id) FROM fdbk_g2) fb_refs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fdbk_g2 f WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM items_g2 i WHERE i.ref_id=f.ref_id)) match_ref, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fdbk_g2 f WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM items_g2 i WHERE i.ref_id=f.item_id)) match_item, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT item_id) FROM fdbk_g2) fb_items

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN prc_usd IS NULL AND prc IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) prc_no_usd, SUM(CASE WHEN prc_usd IS NOT NULL AND prc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) usd_no_prc, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(prc_usd - prc/100.0) > 0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL OR prc_usd IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) total, SUM(CASE WHEN f.rtg=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) one_star,
ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN f.rtg=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) pct
FROM fdbk_g2 f JOIN items_g2 i ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id
WHERE LENGTH(f.body)>500 AND i.prc_usd<=40

SELECT COUNT(*) total, SUM(CASE WHEN f.rtg=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) one_star,
ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN f.rtg=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) pct
FROM fdbk_g2 f JOIN items_g2 i ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id
WHERE LENGTH(f.body)>500 AND i.prc<=4000

SELECT COUNT(*) total, SUM(CASE WHEN f.rtg=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) one_star, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN f.rtg=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) pct
FROM fdbk_g2 f JOIN items_g2 i ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id
WHERE LENGTH(f.body)>500 AND i.prc_usd<=40 AND i.main_cat='All Electronics'
